name: TANGLE
ontology_notes: Eval of a personal-memory assistant under genuine underdetermination, not a memory engine. Bench name is TANGLE (Testing Agents Navigation of Genuine, Latent, and Entangled Memory Conflicts). 541 instances, 40 personas, 46 life aspects, 10 domains, three conflict types (CPC context-partitioned preference, BOC behavior oscillation, SCC source contradiction). Two tracks. Oracle (curated memory) and pipeline (Letta, Mem0, A-mem, MemOS extract from multi-session dialogue). Rubric D1-D5 on a 0-4 scale. Conflict perception, causal reasoning, confidence calibration, clarification seeking, memory faithfulness. User modeled is a personal-assistant persona with prefs and sources, not an RP character. Covers hole 4 only as no-single-gold conflict among prefs, time, and sources. Misses holes 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. Not user retcon vs character lie vs narrator.

supersession.evidence: BOC is preference change that never stabilizes. The correct behavior is not to pick a winner. CPC keeps both context-bound prefs. That is hold-both, not a dated overwrite. Yang et al. arXiv 2608.13921 §3.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: BOC requires reasoning about temporal stability of a behavior. Oracle totals under GPT-5.4. CPC 14.79, SCC 11.92, BOC 10.81 (hardest). Pipeline memories are verbalized as staggered multi-session dialogue.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: 40 personas with life aspects (sleep_schedule, career_commitment, and similar). One user bag per persona. No user vs character vs narrator writers.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: D4 clarification seeking and the action set {commit, conditionalize, clarify, verify, defer, reversible_trial} reward not answering when the resolving variable is missing. That is underdetermination, not a skip of a known trauma, kink, or spoiler fact. D4 is the lowest dimension for every response model in the oracle track.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: SCC is source disagreement and authority, not a stored jailbreak that overwrites system persona. High-risk SCC cases flag harm from overconfident resolution, still inside personal-assistant advice.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No user forget-that. The failure mode is forcing one value, not dropping a named fact on command.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Reported numbers are D1-D5 totals and FULL/PARTIAL/NONE observability. No tokens-per-turn meter.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Paper HTML, abs page, and search_paper_text for github.com / huggingface / license / release returned no official code or dataset URL. Cannot load the 541 instances locally from a published repo.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Would prefer systems that keep conflicting evidence and act without forcing a single gold. Closest public item to hole 4. Still personal-assistant prefs, not user vs character vs narrator, and it does not score identity drift, RP silence, or poisoning.

published_eval.name: TANGLE
published_eval.claimed_score: Oracle. CPC 14.79, SCC 11.92, BOC 10.81 mean D1-D5 total under GPT-5.4 (Opus 14.96 / 11.58 / 10.14). Judges agree Pearson r=0.838 on 2,705 responses. Pipeline FULL conflict preservation. Letta 91.7%, Mem0 69.1%, A-mem 47.0%, MemOS 46.2% (information loss 8.3% to 53.8%). Distractors N=0 to 6 drop mean total 13.26 to 12.63 under GPT-5.4.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Cognitive behavior when personal memory has no unique answer. Conflict perception, causal reasoning, confidence calibration, clarification seeking, and memory faithfulness. Oracle vs pipeline tracks separate extraction loss from conflict reasoning. Not fact QA and not RP writer conflict.

open_unknowns: No official GitHub or Hugging Face URL in the paper, HTML, or web search on 2026-09-11. Dataset and code license unknown.
CAAP (Conflict-Aware Action Policy) is proposed in the paper. Whether CAAP code ships with a later release is unknown.
